Rule.name: HR CSV - Customization
Rule.Description: Runs for every row read from the HR CSV during aggregation. - Trims all string values and turns empty strings into null - Validates startDate / endDate are in DD-MM-YYYY format - Normalises isManager to Y or N (blank or invalid values become N) - Calculates "status" (PreHire / Active / Terminated) and "inactive"
